tools.name: microsoft_word_smart_create_from_markdown
tools.description:
⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='microsoft_word_smart_create_from_markdown', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

🤖 SMART TOOL v2.0: Create professionally formatted Word document from markdown with FULL FORMATTING support. Converts AI-generated markdown into native Word formatting using python-docx library.

✨ COMPLETE MARKDOWN SUPPORT (30+ Features):

📝 TEXT FORMATTING:
- **bold** or __bold__ → Bold text
- *italic* or _italic_ → Italic text
- __underline__ → Underlined text (double underscore)
- ~~strikethrough~~ → Strikethrough text
- ==highlight== → Yellow highlighted text
- `inline code` → Monospace code
- H~2~O → Subscript (H₂O)
- x^2^ → Superscript (x²)

📊 STRUCTURE:
- # to ###### → 6 heading levels (H1-H6)
- - or * → Bullet lists
- 1. 2. 3. → Numbered lists
-   - (2 spaces) → Nested lists (unlimited levels)
- | Tables | → Professional tables with styling
- ```code blocks``` → Monospace code blocks
- > Blockquotes → Indented quotes

🎨 SPECIAL ELEMENTS:
- --- or *** → Horizontal line
- <<PAGE-BREAK>> or <<< → Page break
- ![alt](url) → Images from URLs
- [Link](url) → Hyperlinks (blue, underlined)

📐 ALIGNMENT:
- ->centered text<- → Center aligned
- <-left text → Left aligned
- right text-> → Right aligned

✅ AUTO-SHAREABLE: Documents automatically shareable with edit permissions

Perfect for: AI reports, technical docs, business proposals, formatted content

markdown_content.description: Markdown-formatted text with FULL support: **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, ~~strike~~, ==highlight==, H~2~O, x^2^, tables, lists, images, page breaks, alignment

tools.returns: Dict with document_id, web_url, size, shareable status, share_link
use_cases: Convert AI-generated markdown reports to Word (with highlighting, strikethrough, subscript)
Create formatted documentation from markdown (with images, page breaks, alignment)
Generate professional documents with tables, nested lists, and advanced formatting
Transform markdown notes into Word with full formatting preservation
Create scientific documents with subscript/superscript (H~2~O, E=mc^2^)
Build business proposals with highlighted sections and page breaks
